description:
Port knocking client for FwKnop (Single Packet Authorization) FwKnop-ng is an Android client for fwknop (Single Packet Authorization). It sends an encrypted, authenticated SPA packet that makes a fwknopd server open a firewall port for your IP address. Features
  • Rijndael (AES) and GPG (via OpenKeychain) encryption, HMAC authentication
  • Configurations stored encrypted (Android Keystore, Tink, SQLCipher)
  • Optional app lock (biometrics or device credential)
  • Encrypted backup and restore of all configurations
  • Import/export of configurations through QR codes
  • NFC tag triggered knocks
Note: configurations are bound to the device's Android Keystore. Removing the screen lock or a factory reset makes them unrecoverable: keep your fwknop keys elsewhere, or use the encrypted backup.
